findings.failureScenario: crates/raw/tests/corpus.rs repeats the 'read corpus file, else eprintln skip: <name> absent and continue/return' block at 22 sites (two spellings: let-else Ok and a match on ErrorKind::NotFound), roughly 4-8 lines each. Each new corpus test copies it again, and the spellings already differ on whether a non-NotFound IO error panics (match form) or is silently skipped (let-else form).
findings.action: Add one helper such as fn corpus_file(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> that reads the file, prints the skip line on NotFound and panics on other errors, and use it in every test; expected net cut of about 60-80 lines.

findings.failureScenario: headless.rs open-codes std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("lc-...-{pid}")) + remove_dir_all + create_dir_all in 30 tests, and the same helper is separately redefined as fn temp_dir(tag) in about 19 other test modules (engine tests_*.rs, tests_preset_import.rs, tests_keyword_files.rs, preview/src/tests.rs, catalog/src/tests_lock.rs). Each also hand-rolls cleanup, so a failing assert leaks the directory and a stale pid-named dir can collide.
findings.action: Provide one shared test helper (a test-support crate fn or the tempfile crate's TempDir with auto-cleanup) and replace the 30 inline sites and the per-module temp_dir copies.

findings.failureScenario: develop_paste_validates..., develop_sync_validates..., develop_copy_and_paste_previous_validate_groups and presets_validate_groups_on_create_and_update re-state the same sequence (bogus group names, a 5-7 entry list of wrong-typed JSON, valid subset, omitted, explicit null) with only the command name changed; paste and sync are near line-for-line copies of about 70 lines each. A new group-taking command needs another 70-line copy.
findings.action: Drive the shared cases from one table: a helper taking (command, params-builder) that runs the invalid-name and invalid-type lists and asserts BadParams plus zero mutation, then keep only the command-specific happy-path assertions per test.
